name: RARE Air: Daily Trivia
subtitle: Rare answers. Higher flights.
shortDescription: Daily trivia. Rare answers lift your balloon. Play online or practice offline.
promotionalText: Explore 54 free trivia chapters, build a daily streak and invite friends to Sky Relay. Ten languages, rare answers and a sky full of surprises.
description:
Take your knowledge above the clouds.

RARE Air is an open-answer trivia game about finding the less obvious answer. Each flight gives you five questions and 30 seconds per question. Type one correct answer and your hot-air balloon climbs. Rarer answers give you a bigger lift.

A FRESH DAILY FLIGHT
Everyone gets the same five prompts each day. Explore geography, science, books, films, history and everyday knowledge. A new challenge opens at midnight UTC.

FIND YOUR UPDRAFT
Correct answers earn 100, 250, 500 or 1,000 meters, based on fixed editorial rarity tiers. Aim for a 5,000-meter flight and review accepted answers after the final stage.

A SKY THAT RESPONDS
Drag your balloon to steer. Tap it to catch a gust. Rare answers bring cloud breakthroughs, wind rings and paper-plane companions. Turn on sound for extra atmosphere. Native haptics add feedback on supported devices, and reduced-motion settings simplify the flight.

KEEP EXPLORING
Choose from nine free practice topics online, take a mixed five-question flight, revisit past daily flights, or play from 601 bundled practice prompts offline. Completed daily and offline flight history stays on your device.

FLIGHT ROUTES
Explore nine free routes with six chapters each. Complete five questions to open the next chapter, save your best altitude and collect up to three stars.

DAILY STREAKS
Complete the current daily flight on consecutive UTC dates. Unlock cosmetic flight trails at 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Choose an earned trail from your flight log.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a private Sky Relay room for 2–6 pilots. Share a room code, take turns naming unused answers and keep ahead of a shared countdown. Three hearts and five stages decide the final standings.

TEN LANGUAGES
Choose English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Russian, Arabic or Indonesian. Answer in your selected language or English.

SHARE YOUR FLIGHT
Send a spoiler-free scorecard through your phone’s share sheet. Compare daily altitudes on the anonymous leaderboard.

Daily challenges, online practice, chapters, streak progress, multiplayer, the archive and leaderboards require an internet connection. Offline practice works without a connection. Rarity tiers are curated editorial ratings. The game is free and has no in-app purchases.
reviewNotes:
No player sign-in or payment is required. Choose a language from the top navigation. Daily, topic practice, routes, streak progress and Sky Relay use https://krillionunlimited.top. Offline practice packages 601 prompts and scores locally.

For chapter review, choose Flight routes, select a topic and open Chapter 1. Complete its five questions to unlock Chapter 2. The flight log shows UTC daily streaks and cosmetic trails, unlocked at best streaks of 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Archive replays and offline practice do not extend a streak.

For multiplayer, choose Play with friends, enter a nickname and create a room. A second device or browser can join with the code. The host starts when at least two pilots have joined. Rooms expire after 24 hours.

Each single-player flight has five rounds. Choose Climb higher after the reward screen. A three-second preparation countdown reveals the next prompt and starts its 30-second clock. Online active timers continue while backgrounded. The final report shows accepted answers and native score sharing. Drag or tap the balloon for flight effects. Sound starts off. Haptics need supported hardware. Rarity uses fixed editorial tiers.

The MIT-licensed source is at https://github.com/glovenone/rare-air.
